name: AssayBench-Loop test split (20 genome-wide CRISPR screens published after 2021)
description: The 20 temporally held-out test screens of AssayBench-Loop, each a genome-wide CRISPR screen with binary hit labels.

attributes.split: Temporal: 1,349 training screens before 2021, 20 validation screens from 2021, 20 test screens after 2021
attributes.subset_scope: Test screens were restricted to genome-wide coverage (18,000-22,000 genes), at least 50 hits with hit rate below 15%, and a best-LLM AnDCG@100 of at least 0.05 (Gemini 3.1 Pro on AssayBench); phenotype categories were allocated from the eligible pool with a soft cap of six per category, and within-category diversity of screen descriptions was maximised.
attributes.source_dataset: AssayBench (1,920 CRISPR screens); the test pool is AssayBench's post-2021 split
limitations: Screens were selected, not sampled: the criteria include a performance floor for the best LLM on AssayBench, which conditions the test set on LLM-recoverable hits.
Hit labels are each screen's own published significance call; the candidate pool G (about 20,000 genes) is larger than each screen library, so genes outside the library cannot be scored.

Not linked same_data_as to tgtval-20261009-data-assaybench-test: the 20 screens are a selected subset of AssayBench's post-2021 test pool (Methods 4.2), not the same data, and their identities (Supplementary Table 2) were not matched to AssayBench entries.
